010000111222333102132030 - ASI: 22

Rules:
  00 = 0 * 0
  10 = 1 * 0
  11 = 1 * 1
  22 = 2 * 2
  30 = 3 * 0
  32 = 3 * 2
  33 = 3 * 3
  000 = 0 * 00
  010 = 0 * 10
  030 = 0 * 30
  102 = 10 * 2
  111 = 1 * 11
  132 = 1 * 32
  222 = 2 * 22
  333 = 3 * 33
  010000 = 010 * 000
  111222 = 111 * 222
  132030 = 132 * 030
  333102 = 333 * 102
  010000111222 = 010000 * 111222
  333102132030 = 333102 * 132030
  010000111222333102132030 = 010000111222 * 333102132030
